Sandbox_PhunSpawn_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging for point registration, discovery and spawning
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_UseSpawnRoom_tooltip: If yes, a new character wakes up in an off grid arrival room rather than on the spawn square, so the first thirty seconds are theirs. Needs PhunInteriors; with it absent the character is placed at the point itself
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_DiscoveryRadius_toolti: How close you have to get to a spawn point that is a place rather than a pay phone before you remember it. There is nothing at a place to pick up, so this cannot be 0. Pay phones have their own range
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_ShowUndiscovered_toolt: If yes, places you have not found are listed greyed out, so the list is somewhere to head for. If no, they are not sent to your client at all
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_AllowBuiltPoints_toolt: If yes, a player may build a pay phone from a crafted kit, for anybody to find and use
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_BuiltPointLimit_toolti: How many pay phones one player may have standing at once. Set to 0 for no limit
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_RespawnPenalty_tooltip: If yes, choosing where to wake up costs the new character something. Off by default
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_PhoneChance_tooltip: Percent chance a vanilla pay phone is replaced by one that is a spawn point, rolled once per phone the first time it loads. Set to 0 to turn the swap off
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_PhoneDistance_tooltip: No pay phone is replaced within this many squares of one that already has been. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_PhoneRing_tooltip: If yes, a pay phone you have not discovered yet rings now and then while you are near it, so it is easier to notice
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_PhoneRingRange_tooltip: How close, in squares, you have to be for an undiscovered pay phone to ring for you
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_BuiltPhoneDistance_too: A player cannot build a pay phone within this many squares of any other. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_PhoneDiscoverRadius_to: How close, in squares, you have to get to a pay phone to remember it, and it rings once to say so. Set to 0 and you have to pick the phone up
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_TaxiFastTravel_tooltip: If yes, a player can call a taxi from any pay phone they know to any other, for a fare. The first ride, out of the spawn room, is always free
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_TaxiCentsPerSquare_too: Cents of PhunMart change per square travelled. Needs PhunMart unless this and the minimum fare are both 0
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_TaxiMinimumFare_toolti: The least any taxi ride costs, in cents
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_TaxiZombieRadius_toolt: A taxi will not come while a zombie is within this many squares. Set to 0 to turn this off
